title: saveRealFla drops flaSwfBlobs — the CPicSwf raw bytes the importer explicitly preserves 'for lossless re-export' are never re-emitted
description: FIXED: saveRealFla now re-emits preserved CPicSwf blobs (doc.flaSwfBlobs) on the write path. fla-write.ts groups blobs by sceneIndex into each Page N stream; timeline-write.ts emits them into the first CPicFrame framed by a CPicSwf class tag (ClassTable keeps the §5.2 index consistent); emitting blobs LAST lets the frame's null+INT_MIN sentinel form the 10-byte object-tail that terminates the reader's re-sync scan. Symbol-timeline blobs (sceneIndex undefined, no symbol ref) are dropped with a console.warn + documented in docs/21 §22 (needs a read-path capture change, task 1411). Round-trip tests in real-fla-write.test.ts: import->export->re-import of fixtures/Magnet.fla recovers all 4 CPicSwf blob bodies byte-identically; synthetic single/multi/orphan cases pass. Verified: full ordered build 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0; core tests 'vitest run' 5719 passed | 8 skipped (66 in real-fla-write incl 5 new).
